question: How much of each salt was dissolved per litre to make the three draw solutions, and to what osmotic pressure?
expect: NaCl 35.0 g/L, MgSO4.7H2O 71.8 g/L, sodium acetate 79.4 g/L, each to 30 bar at 25 C (sec. 2.2)
rendered:
To make the draw solutions, the following salts were dissolved per liter:

- NaCl (35.0 g L^−1)
- MgSO4·7H2O (71.8 g L^−1)
- sodium acetate (79.4 g L^−1)

The draw solutions were prepared to provide an initial nominal osmotic pressure of 30 bar at 25 °C.
